input.overview: Build chips while completing the six C-A-S-I-N-O features. The first Multiball needs a Slot Shot: open its ramp with consecutive Winning Streak loops or the lit right return lane, then shoot down the ramp to lock a ball. The machine serves a second ball for a skill shot and begins two-ball Winning Streak Multiball.
input.simpleOverview: Make consecutive Winning Streak loops or roll through the lit right return lane to open the Slot Shot. Shoot down the open ramp to lock a ball and begin two-ball Winning Streak Multiball. Use Multiball to build chips on the loop and safely finish Blackjack because the Bust target is disabled.
input.summary: Make consecutive Winning Streak loops or use the lit right return lane to open the Slot Shot, then shoot down its ramp to lock a ball and start two-ball Winning Streak Multiball. Loop Winning Streak for chips; use the disabled Bust target to finish Blackjack safely.

quickInfo.name: Open Slot Shot
quickInfo.summary: Make consecutive Winning Streak loops or roll through the lit right return lane.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot down the open Slot Shot ramp; the lock serves a second ball and starts two-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Light Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Fill the Win Meter, then use Roulette to risk chips for the displayed Jackpot.

steps.text: Make consecutive Winning Streak loops, or use the lit right return lane, to lower the Slot Shot ramp.
Shoot down the open Slot Shot ramp to lock a ball; play the served skill shot and continue into two-ball Winning Streak Multiball.
During Multiball, repeat the Winning Streak loop to advance the Win Meter and collect chips.
Prepare Blackjack at two sevens before Multiball, then hit the center target while Bust is disabled to collect it safely.

alternatives.title: Complete C-A-S-I-N-O
alternatives.when: Use this after the first Multiball route is under control.

steps.text: Collect Five Card, Blackjack, Slot, the served Skill Shot, Roulette, and CHIPS to spell C-A-S-I-N-O.
Use Royal Flush as the final letter when possible; it can remain available for another collection after C-A-S-I-N-O is completed.
Collect casino wins, loop Winning Streak, and complete C-A-S-I-N-O features to advance the Win Meter.
When Roulette is lit for Jackpot, shoot it only with enough chips to accept losing half of the current bank.
Keep the loop route as the dependable scorer; the Jackpot is a Roulette result, not a standard Multiball shot.

machineSetup: Confirm the Roulette risk, extra-ball, and progressive-Jackpot settings before competitive play.
Test the Winning Streak loop, right return lane, Slot Shot lift and lock, skill-shot lanes, center Blackjack target, and Roulette saucer.

cautions.issue: Winning Streak Multiball does not use a conventional Jackpot shot.
cautions.response: Use its loop to build chips and the Win Meter; the eventual Jackpot chance is collected through Roulette.
